title: AL Language extension for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central – versions
summary: A changelog summary page for the AL Language extension covering versions from 4.0.0 to 30.0, aligned with Business Central releases from 2017 through 2027 wave 1. It references the official VS Code marketplace changelog and details compiler features, bug fixes, and language improvements across multiple years.
key_points: AL Language versions range from early 2017 updates (0.2 to 0.13) through Business Central 2027 release wave 1 (version 30.0)
Recent versions add support for markdown page fields, multi-pair ModifyAll operations, snapshot debugging for tests, document media types, and ternary operators
The extension handles compiler optimizations like parallel workspace compilation, AppSourceCop rule updates, and improved error diagnostics
Agent and copilot features integrated including GPT-5.3-chat model upgrades and searchable downloaded symbols
Bug fixes address issues with publishing, packaging, formatting, debugging, and language server functionality

quotes.text: Apps can now expose selected packaged resources to other apps.
quotes.why_it_matters: Enables better code organization and reusability by allowing extensions to share resources across app boundaries

quotes.text: We have introduced a new handler type HttpClientHandler to allow mocking the response of HTTP requests in test codeunits.
quotes.why_it_matters: Facilitates better testing practices by enabling developers to mock external HTTP dependencies in AL tests
